contract.title: Adversarial E0 calibration plan review
contract.goal: Read the exact GitHub main files, propose at most four atomic dependency-ordered overnight work packages, and attack the plan for confounding, post-hoc thresholds, fake pairing, semantic-changing optimizations, and claim overreach. Each package must include purpose, why now, exclusions, exact allowed paths, implementation, tests and counterexamples, local/CI/VM acceptance, stop conditions, a complete executor prompt, allowed conclusions, and forbidden conclusions. Prefer extension of existing components over a parallel framework. Explicitly identify what must close before Q0 real replay and which optimizations are semantics-preserving only.
acceptance: At most four work packages with strict dependencies and overnight atomic scope
Every proposed change names existing exact paths or clearly justified new files
At least one counterexample each for access bottleneck, horizon truncation, information truncation, and non-ISL pressure
No claim of algorithm superiority, Q0 optimality, or paper readiness
requiredEvidence: GitHub file and line references for every repository-dependent claim
Explicit FACT, INFERENCE, and open_items separation
